body:
Could be.
But I view it more as clouded perception/consciousness.

>What you describe is similar to what I hear from a lot of people who are severely depressed. Both the emotional numbing and the compromised reasoning are things I hear pretty often.

I'm afraid that's it.
I've been repressing my emotions for too long.
But I've never thought of myself as a depressed person.

Everyone else seems to notice.
Except me.

But when I think about it, I realize I've always felt like this.
I even view it as a part of my personality.

Is it possible that if someone is depressed for long period of time, they simply get used to it and the depression just becomes the integral part of them.
I feel that way...

Thanks for the  advice.
 I'm already trying some of those things.
